characteristics: Fixed-wing, operates in a hunter-killer pair with a separate Spectre reconnaissance drone
Strength: Domestic design paired specifically with its own reconnaissance drone for a purpose-built kill chain, rather than relying on ad hoc pairing
Limitation: Less publicly documented performance data than Western-donated or more famous domestic systems like Bayraktar
Estimated quantity available: Fielded numbers not publicly disclosed
employment_notes: An early and influential domestic hunter-killer pairing concept that prefigured the reconnaissance-strike drone pairing pattern now standard across the war
contrast_vs_traditional: A domestically developed strike UAV built specifically for Ukraine's own operating pattern reflects the doctrine.md force-structure point about decentralized procurement: units and volunteer developers are fielding purpose-built strike drones on their own timeline rather than waiting on a centralized program to specify and procure one, the same bottom-up pattern documented for EW gear.
